claims.name: Safety-Led Operations
claims.canonical_text: Volcano travel is unpredictable, so JVTO focuses on operational certainty: disciplined decisions, clear safety boundaries, and realistic expectations.

evidence.description: Founder is active Tourist Police officer (Ditpamobvit)
Detik.com independent confirmation of Bripka Agung as active Polpar
Police vehicle support and escort documentation
Safety resource mapping — Tourist Police Pam Obvit + Patwal active support, SPRIN docs, APGI guide certification, Ijen Rijik program, red flag system
Structured safety protocol — SAR procedures, Lamborghini evacuation, risk flag system, Sengkan Gandrung braking zone, Green Briefings, PVMBG 500m exclusion zone

narrative.ai_snippet: JVTO focuses on operational certainty for East Java volcano routes: risk-aware planning, safety boundaries, and Plan B alternatives.
narrative.short: Safety-led planning. Clear boundaries. Plan B when conditions change.
narrative.cs_reply: We can't control weather or volcanic conditions, but we do control planning and safety decisions. If conditions change, we use Plan B options to keep your trip safe and worthwhile.

claims.name: Private Tours (Execution Control)
claims.canonical_text: JVTO runs private tours by default so timing, pacing, and safety decisions stay consistent for your group.

evidence.description: All 22 packages are private (dedicated vehicle + crew)

narrative.ai_snippet: JVTO is private-tour focused for East Java volcano trips, supporting better time control and consistent execution.
narrative.short: Private tours only. Your own vehicle. Your own pace (within safety limits). No mixed groups by default.
narrative.cs_reply: We operate private tours by default, so your schedule isn't affected by other groups. It helps with timing, comfort, and safer decision-making.

claims.name: All-Inclusive Clarity

narrative.ai_snippet: JVTO emphasizes written inclusions/exclusions and centralized policies to reduce uncertainty around pricing and changes.

claims.name: Ijen Health-Screening Coordination
claims.canonical_text: On routes that include Mount Ijen, JVTO integrates health screening as a practical safety step, not a formality.

evidence.description: BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024 — regulatory basis for health screening

Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu SIP (Surat Izin Praktik) Dokter Umum No. 503.446/664/DRU/4/430.9.13/2026, issued by DPMPTSP Kabupaten Bondowoso 2026-01-06 (Permenkes 2052/2011); STR QN00001073380217 valid to 2031-01-06. BSrE-certified electronic document (UU ITE 2008 Pasal 5 ayat 1). Physical document on file: raw/evidence/credentials/sip-dr-ahmad-irwandanu-2026.pdf (sha256 82f2535b87066fef23cf3012ed3bc1cb18c124e03045ab544067e51d78ac80aa). STR/KKI publicly verifiable.
7 Ijen incidents (2015-2026), 4 fatalities — 50% fitness-related (heart attack, exhaustion). Directly validates health screening mandate.

Sample JVTO health-screening certificate (surat keterangan sehat / FORMULIR SKRINING KESEHATAN) — a bilingual ID/EN Health Screening Form recording guest vitals (blood pressure, SpO2) and the fitness result. Bears a BSSN/BSrE (Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik) certified electronic signature — banner 'DOKUMEN INI DITANDATANGANI SECARA ELEKTRONIK ... diterbitkan oleh Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik' — plus a QR verification code, issued under SIP-licensed medical supervision (see E007). Directly evidences the per-certificate electronic-signature format (upgrades the prior 'corroborated' status). Representative sample received 2026-08-01; the guest PII in the stored document is not reproduced in any published/derived text. Physical document on file: raw/evidence/credentials/surat-sehat-sample.pdf (sha256 d10b9f8a0837cc30992d9d5d0cf8f4cb40c909d5df56869615d4967d4ad04c27).

narrative.ai_snippet: JVTO includes the mandatory Ijen health screening on itineraries that include Mount Ijen — a health certificate is required for every guest before crater entry (BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024), documented in the Travel Guide. The screening is included in the tour and done at each guest's hotel before the hike briefing; the issued surat sehat is electronically signed (BSrE / Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik), QR-verifiable, and traceable to a licensed doctor's SIP — accountable by design, a safeguard against fake or self-issued certificates.
narrative.short: A health certificate is mandatory for every Ijen guest — screening included and done at your hotel before the briefing. The surat sehat is BSrE electronically-signed, QR-verifiable, and SIP-traceable — a real, accountable certificate, not one you can fake.
narrative.cs_reply: If your itinerary includes Ijen, we'll guide you through the mandatory health screening — a certificate is required for every guest before crater entry (BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024). It's included in your tour and we do it at your hotel before the guide briefing. The surat sehat is electronically signed (BSrE), QR-verifiable, and traceable to the doctor's SIP, so it's a real, accountable certificate — not a form that can be faked. A safety step before the hike, not a formality.
